Method of Attack: Exploitation of cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability to re-enable 'nodeIntegration' at runtime, allowing remote code execution.
Impacted Systems: Electron-based applications such as WhatsApp, Skype, Signal, Wordpress, Slack, GitHub Desktop, Atom, Visual Studio Code, Discord
Attack Vector: Cross-site scripting (XSS) flaw to inject malicious code and re-enable 'nodeIntegration'
